t2_profile.source: contended overlap run inside rp_w1ffno 7281574 on a0172 (clean rerun: rp_swinprof)
t2_profile.reading: 706 CUDA kernels per batch-1 fp16 forward vs FNO 239; aten::copy_ x325 is the largest device op (window partition/merge copies and autocast fp32<->fp16 casts around LayerNorm/normalize). EXACT and cheap: cache logit scale + position bias + shift-mask sums at load (-0.57 ms, -212 kernels, -27 %), gather-based partition (-0.03 ms more); fp32 is FASTER than fp16 at batch 1 (fewer casts): cache+gather fp32 1.17 ms = 1.06x FNO fp16. Keep the mem-efficient SDPA (math +0.18 ms). Ablations: the 4 ConvNeXt skip blocks cost 0.26 ms, shifts 0.07, refine ~0.
